mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, disease_code, schema_version, content_json, version, source, created_by_staff_id, updated_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM people_disease_archive WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY disease_code
mapper.update: UPDATE people_disease_archive SET content_json = #{contentJson}, schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, version = #{version}, updated_by_staff_id = #{updatedByStaffId}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
